title: These Birds Are Louder Than Elephants, Jackhammers and Chain Saws
summary_full: A new study has identified two species of Brazilian birds, the bare-throated bellbird and the red-legged seriema, as the loudest in nature.
summary_public: A new study has identified two species of Brazilian birds, the bare-throated bellbird and the red-legged seriema, as the loudest in nature.
